static_traits.name: Li Li
static_traits.social_status: Relationships with friends affected, tending to avoid Social gatherings involving photos
static_traits.medical_history: Without significant physical illness; never received psychotherapy before; never experienced similar psychological problems
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, good logic; Neutral attitude; initially tense but highly cooperative

basic_info.main_problem: I believe I like painting others rather than myself, because I am ugly; this leads to negative self-perception and Avoiding self-portraits; I avoid looking in mirrors or taking selfies, affecting confidence and artistic expression.
basic_info.core_demands: I realize that negative beliefs about appearance are hindering my artistic growth and self-acceptance, so I seek counseling.
growth_experiences: Beginning in adolescence, due to society's standards of beauty and others' past negative comments about my appearance, I formed and internalized the belief 'I am ugly'. This belief gradually affected my self-image and confidence, so that when I try to draw a self-portrait or see my reflection in the mirror I have strong negative experiences, and I further avoid mirrors, selfies and social occasions involving being photographed, affecting artistic creation and daily self-care.

special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I look ugly, painting myself will only highlight my flaws
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoiding self-portraits, painting only others instead
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am ugly, the painting will turn out terrible

special_situations.event: Sees herself in the mirror or notices her own reflection
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If seeing myself makes me feel unbearable negative emotions, it means I really am ugly
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I look terrible, better not to look

special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If photographed, others will notice my flaws and think I am ugly
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids social activities involving photos; reduces interaction with friends
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They will think I am not good-looking

special_situations.event: Others praising my appearance or work
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Others' positive feedback is not reliable or just polite, unable to change the fact that I am 'ugly'
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Negating or ignoring positive evaluations, maintaining negative self-perception
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They are just comforting me, it is not real

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be seen and accepted (including self-acceptance and self-presentation in art)
core_conflict.fear: Fearing being negated, ridiculed or rejected because of appearance, being judged after exposing one's flaws
defense_goal: Lowering the risk of being negated by Avoiding self-portraits, avoiding mirrors and photos, maintaining fragile self-worth

object_relations.self_representation: Oneself not deserving to be seen, flawed and shameful
object_relations.object_representation: A critical judge (others / society's standards of beauty)

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor invites them to set small goals related to self-portraits or discuss others' positive feedback on their appearance
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Subconsciously seeing the outside world as critical judges who will negate him, believing self-presentation will inevitably trigger negative evaluations (transference: Projection)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Using a gentle, supportive tone; first empathizing with their shame and nervousness, avoiding direct refutation; guiding them to specify situations and evidence with open-ended questions; offering small-step options, emphasizing autonomy and control; avoiding forced emphasis on appearance evaluation.

manifestations: Avoiding Social gatherings involving photos, reducing interaction with friends
Friends do not understand the extent of their negative self-perception and avoidance behaviors
outcomes: Increased Social avoidance and sense of alienation

manifestations: Influenced by societal beauty standards and others' comments, struggling to present oneself freely (self-portraits)
Artistic expression dominated by external evaluation
outcomes: Creative Freedom limited, artistic growth hindered

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: Internalizes society's standards of beauty and others' negative comments into self-evaluation
Treating 'I am ugly' as established fact, struggling to absorb positive feedback

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves; that is, the individual redirects energy originally intended outward toward themselves, corresponding to 'impulse'.
manifestations: Not revealing to friends the true extent of negative self-perception and avoidance behaviors
Turning social discomfort into self-avoidance and self-criticism (such as avoiding photos, avoiding mirrors)

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Judging oneself harshly with the 'I am ugly' label, struggling to internalize others' praise
Excessively cautious and avoidant in self-presentation (self-portraits, selfies)

positive_force: When painting for others, feels confident and engaged, has artistic expression ability
Proactively seeks counseling, willing to try 'small steps forward' self-portrait exercises
Has a few close friends she can talk with (potential support resources)
negative_force: Internalizing societal beauty standards and others' negative comments as self-labels (I am ugly)
Negating positive feedback, struggling to absorb praise and exception evidence
Persistently avoiding mirrors, selfies and photo-involving social situations, reinforcing negative self-schemas
Maladaptive cognitive patterns such as emotional reasoning and mind reading intensify Self-denial

antecedent: Thinking about doing a self-portrait exercise
target_behavior.core_reason: Internalizing societal beauty standards and others' negative comments in adolescence, forming the 'I am ugly' core belief, and treating negative feelings as facts through emotional reasoning.
target_behavior.function: Escaping visible flaws and potential shame, lowering Anxiety and Self-denial
target_behavior.consequence: Artistic expression and creative development are restricted; self-presentation in the works is lacking

target_behavior.behavior: Avoids looking in mirrors and taking photos (including selfies and social activities involving photos)
antecedent: Seeing a mirror or one's own reflection
Entering social settings where photos might be taken
Being invited by others for a group photo or selfie
target_behavior.core_reason: Internalizing appearance criticism as stable labels, predicting others' negative evaluations and deepening shame and Anxiety through emotional reasoning.
target_behavior.function: Avoids external evaluation and negative emotional experiences, maintaining fragile self-worth
target_behavior.consequence: Decreased self-confidence, social relationships affected, daily self-care habits impaired
